Up in a red oak this summer, taking a failed leader back to the trunk so the rest of the tree can keep going. Climbing lets us make the right cut without dropping anything on the yard, the river, or the footbridge below.

If a big limb on your property is cracked or hanging, send us a photo and we'll tell you what it needs.

This is what a hollow trunk looks like from the outside. The cavity at the base tells the story: the tree was carrying a lot of weight on not much wood, right next to the power lines.

We took it down in sections before the wind could do it for us. If you have a tree with a hole, a mushroom shelf, or bark falling off near the base, that's worth a look before winter.

#PeekskillNY #TreeService #Arborist #HudsonValley #Westchester #Putnam #SecondNatureTree

After the July 5 storm we documented a big multi-stem tree that lost a leader mid-trunk, with the broken section hung up over the yard. Photos, the diameter, and a written scope went straight to the homeowner's insurance carrier.

Storm damage claims go smoother with a proper arborist report. We do those.

Last call: Nextdoor's Fave Awards voting closes tonight, Sept 30. A Fave on our page takes 30 seconds: https://nextdoor.com/pages/second-nature-tree-peekskill-ny/

The part of the job nobody photographs: the cleanup. Logs on the loader, brush chipped, the driveway blown off before we leave.

We leave a yard the way we found it, minus the problem tree. That's the whole point.

#PeekskillNY #TreeService #Arborist #HudsonValley #Westchester #Putnam #SecondNatureTree

A dead hemlock leaning into the wires beside a footbridge. Dead trees near lines don't announce when they're coming down.

We worked with the utility clearance and took it out piece by piece. If you've got a dead tree anywhere near a service drop, call us before the first ice storm does.

#PeekskillNY #TreeService #Arborist #HudsonValley #Westchester #Putnam #SecondNatureTree

Not every big tree needs to come down. This oak got a cable system high in the canopy so the two main stems can't split apart in a storm. Ten years of shade for a fraction of a removal.

We'll always tell you honestly whether a tree can be saved.

#PeekskillNY #TreeService #Arborist #HudsonValley #Westchester #Putnam #SecondNatureTree

The dead ash next to this house came out this year. Emerald ash borer has killed most of the ash in Northern Westchester and Putnam, and dead ash gets brittle fast.

If you have an ash with thinning canopy, woodpecker holes, or bark flaking off, fall is the right time to deal with it.

Chestnut oak and dead ash, cut to length and staged for firewood. Nothing we take down goes to waste: logs become firewood, brush becomes wood chips.

Ask us about seasoned firewood for this winter.

Dead trees along a fence line, right over the neighbor's yard. This is the kind of thing that turns into a claim in a February storm.

A quick walk of your property line now saves a lot of trouble later. Free estimates, honest advice.

Sizing up a big multi-stem tree after storm damage. Diameter, lean, where the weight is, what's under it. That's what decides whether it's a prune, a cable, or a removal.

We've been climbing and caring for trees in Peekskill and the surrounding towns for years. Same small crew every time.
